title: Lock screen notifications landing from the camera
summary: A phone drops into a dark frame lit by a blue planet rim, settles on its lock screen, then two glass notifications arrive one at a time: the first lands from the viewer, the second takes the top slot after a push-down.
use_when: A mobile product whose value is a timely alert or message
Showing what the user receives, one event at a time, fully readable
A short silent loop for a feed or a landing-page hero
Opening shot before a longer app walkthrough

look.type_style: lock screen clock: condensed ultra-tall numerals ~40 % of phone height, white; cards: semibold title + regular body, sentence case, dark on light glass, ~2 % H

structure.shot: black frame, blue planet rim bottom-left; phone descends from above the top edge, wallpaper swaps night to sunset
structure.camera: static frame; the device travels down ~1000 px/s (1920 basis) in 0-1 s, ~470 px/s in 2-3 s, rotateX tilt ~5 deg easing to 0
structure.motion: phone enters bottom-first from off-frame on springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable), settles f78; wallpaper cross-dissolve inside the screen 1.77-2.27 s (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: lock screen settled: status bar, date line, huge clock over the sunset wallpaper; rim arc drifting behind
structure.camera: drift: background rim sweeps slowly, phone holds
structure.motion: hold 33 fr; only the backdrop arc moves, easings.linear

structure.shot: first glass notification card lands in the top slot: avatar with app badge, name title, one-line body
structure.motion: land from the camera: scale 1.47 to 1, offset up-left a quarter card width, opacity 0.3 to 1, blur 8 px to 0, easings.landing 7 fr (f111-f118); hold 41 fr

structure.shot: first card pushed down one slot; second card, a message preview, fills the freed top slot
structure.motion: push-down one card height + 8 px gap on springs.layout 10-11 fr (f159-f170); second card fades and blur-ins, scale 1.03 to 1, opacity 0.15 to 1, 6 fr (f176-f182)

structure.shot: two-card stack held on the lock screen; a band of blue light starts to sweep across the top right
structure.camera: drift: background arc slides toward the top right, phone static
structure.motion: hold 57 fr; backdrop arc on easings.linear

structure.shot: same two-card stack; the lit rim now crosses the whole top right of the frame behind the phone
structure.camera: drift: rim arc grows and brightens ~3 %/s at 8-9 s and ~7 %/s in the last second (motion estimate), phone static
structure.motion: hold 118 fr to the end; no element motion, only the backdrop

params.brand: any brand.json: app icon for the card badge, accent tints the rim light, bg behind the phone
params.content.notifications: 2 items, each a title (name, 2-3 words) and a body (one line, 3-5 words)
params.content.wallpaper: lock screen image or gradient; a second image for the in-screen cross-dissolve (optional)
params.content.time: clock string on the lock screen
params.timing.firstLand: frame of the first landing (default 111 at 30 fps)
params.timing.gap: frames between first landing and the push-down (default 48)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; phone height ~1.1 x frame height, cropped at the bottom
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: One continuous shot, 0 cuts. Measured at 30 fps by hand: landing = scale 1.47 to 1 over 7 fr, bezier(0.35,0.05,0.7,1), no overshoot, blur 8 px; push-down 10-11 fr no overshoot (springs.layout); second card lags the push by ~17 fr (consider overlapping it at ~60 % of the push). Card 360x62 px at 720p, radius ~20 px, gap 8 px, light glass with heavy backdrop blur. The backdrop rim never stops, so holds are not dead frames. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms: device-drop-in, screen-crossfade (recipe.md).
